omission.chore: Notify a restaurant when a new order is placed on its website.
omission.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .
omission.reason: The draft excluded this concrete restaurant order-notification chore because no implementation reference supported order triggers or WhatsApp delivery. The discussion-batch policy says a discussion post itself establishes the request and does not require implementation evidence. A limited prototype using supplied or synthetic orders and a test notification could be assessed without claiming live integrations.
